name: Global Rating of Change Scale
description: Patient rates overall change since start of treatment on a ±7 scale (or 1–15). Used as anchor for MCID studies. Multiple versions exist.
shirleySays: Used as anchor for MCID studies across virtually all outcome measures. ICC moderate (0.60–0.75) — recall bias is known limitation. Multiple versions (5-, 7-, 11-, 15-point). Recommend use at every reassessment alongside region-specific PROMs.

scoring.mcidNote: +1/+2 = slightly better; +3/+4 = moderately better; +5 = much better; +6/+7 = very much better
